alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:d19f92.description: Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. Reps are buried in admin work, managers are stretched thin, and leaders can’t see what’s really happening in the field. Siro is redefining how field sales teams learn, perform, and win. We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field. Today, we’re something much bigger — an intelligent companion that automates sales reps’ tedious admin work, gives managers real-time visibility, and helps executives see around corners. Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. Siro has raised $75M and is backed by world-class investors like Index, Fika, CRV, and SignalFire. crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:25.description: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations! Over a half-century of building meaningful relationships with our customers and vendors boils down to one thing: people. We take pride in our collaborative approach where everything we do is designed to deliver the project the right way, your way. Though we have grown over the years, and now offer new innovations like our Factory-Built Substations, our age-old commitment will never change: to take care of you like family. DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations is looking to hire a Welding Technician to work from our Port of Alexandria Facility in our Welding Department. The Welding Technician assists FBS Welders, who perform cutting, fitting, and welding of aluminum bus pipe and cable jumpers. The Technician supports the production process of the PFB in the Project Services Center. The Technician performs skilled work such as, reading blueprints, moving machinery or equipment, including cranes, in order to manipulate the pipe or jumpers. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1078532c-27dc-.title: Business Analyst –Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1078532c-27dc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to shape enterprise-wide strategies for secure data storage, access, classification, and usage. You’ll analyze how systems, tools, endpoints, and business groups handle sensitive information across a complex technology environment. Your work will help identify high-risk data practices and determine where VDI or other secure access and storage approaches can deliver the greatest value. You’ll bridge business, security, and technology teams by translating complex findings into practical recommendations and migration priorities. The position combines business analysis, data governance, security assessment, stakeholder engagement, and technology strategy. You’ll contribute to business cases, migration roadmaps, compliance processes, and executive-level decision-making. It’s an ideal opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst who enjoys solving complex data security challenges and influencing enterprise transformation. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business groups, systems, processes, and workflows. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state models for data storage, access, and usage. Evaluate viable approaches, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management solutions, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering security risks, costs, operational impact, adoption, and business requirements. Analyze and document data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, requirements sessions, and discovery activities across multiple departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and Business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with established data policies. Present analysis, findings, recommendations, and business cases to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a structured migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, risks, and change management considerations. Analyze and help design privileged access management processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Translate complex technical and security findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. 5–7 years of professional Business Analyst experience, including work involving data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, IT infrastructure, endpoint environments, or related initiatives. Proven experience analyzing system usage and data flows across multiple business units, departments, or complex enterprise environments. Strong understanding of secure data storage, data access, classification, governance, and risk assessment principles. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technical domains. Strong stakeholder interview, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and discovery skills. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7cdb49c5-c7e7-.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7cdb49c5-c7e7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Spain. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Requirements: Cybersecurity and threat intelligence interest: Suitable for aspiring CTI analysts, cybersecurity students or graduates, SOC professionals seeking CTI exposure, career changers, intelligence or security professionals transitioning into cyber, self-taught practitioners, and professionals with relevant cybersecurity certifications. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions. Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization.
